propositions: AGENTS.md documents the 800-LOC module-size gate but does not mention the C901 cyclomatic-complexity ratchet, leaving implementers unaware of a blocking structural constraint until pre-flight lint failure.

The C901 ratchet is shrink-only: it fails when functions gain new complexity debt or exceed per-symbol ceilings in .github/complexity-baseline.json (max 15), enforced by scripts/check_complexity_baseline.py and ruff during make lint.
Routine changes like adding CLI flags or guard clauses predictably trigger C901 failures even when LOC and lint/typecheck remain clean, forcing unplanned behavior-preserving extraction work.

The fix to C901 failures is extracting complexity (never bumping the baseline ceiling), and the remedy is invisible to the behavioral test oracle, so implementers need explicit surface documentation to brief the constraint during planning.
